title: Soft-Label Integration for Robust Toxicity Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing and aggregating annotations from multiple sources (human reviewers and various LLMs like GPT-4 and Claude-2) using a learned soft-labeling technique to mitigate the subjective biases and varying quality of individual annotators.

Evaluating out-of-distribution (OOD) risk by measuring worst-group accuracy across data subgroups—constructed using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topics and true labels—to ensure the model does not rely on irrelevant textual features.
